test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 23 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Study the diagram and answer the questions that follow. The numbers in different sections indicate the number of persons. How many women are speakers and NOT professors and how many professors are speakers and NOT women?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f4aed250c772229874a00230617f2549450dc0101124fbd1d6e832a719da9d1.png]
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30ddb96e57cbf59641e210bbcda8789e9de60f3fbb5336cfca8e677197967c67.png] 

→ The number of women who are speakers but not professor = 62 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/70d6a087541d1b90fd630ad209b941e0e142cb3e2e97111c8a5184961ba2b58f.png] 

→ The number of professors who are speakers and not women = 49

Hence, the correct answer is **"62**** and 49, respectively"**.
